_meta.note: Seeded by walking the seven vocab modules under tools/seedsmith/seedsmith/adapters/ (spec-vocabulary-mirror.md's own count). Only tools/seedsmith/seedsmith/adapters/actions/vocab.py's constants are mirrors this checker can verify: each cites a real, simple C# enum (owner.kind csharp-enum) or the status-catalog tuning file (json-catalog). Every OTHER file's candidate constants were read and excluded, on the record, not silently skipped: affixfamgen/opvocab.py's LEGAL_OPS and recipegen/opvocab.py's ALL_OPERATIONS/CATALYST_FOR/etc. mirror a C# DOC-COMMENT vocabulary or need a kebab-case transform this checker does not offer, and both already carry their own corpus-reconciliation drift test (a different, adequate mechanism, not duplicated here); materialgen/vocab.py's SUBSTRATE_FRAMES/SUBSTRATE_GRADES/ELEMENTS/CATALYST_VERBS mirror C# STATIC ARRAYS, not enums; setgen/vocab.py and trees/nodegen/vocab.py declare no vocabulary constants at all (they read affix-family JSON fresh, never transcribe); trees/plan/vocabulary.py's NODE_CLASS/BRANCH/CONVERSION_STATE/EXCLUSION_FORM are the file's OWN explicit comment: 'design-law closed sets stated directly in the spec, not read from a mirror' -- no C# owner exists for them at all. A future pair for any of these needs its own reviewed transform/owner-kind extension, not a forced fit here.
